_comment: Copy to browser_profiles.json and fill real URLs. For FoodKing automation PCs prefer bot-local profile (user_data_dir_relative) — not your main Chrome User Data. Never commit secrets.

claude._expected_chat_url_hint: Same string as start_url for the 00_ORCHESTRATOR chat — strict URL guard. Optional hub URLs are documentation-only.
claude._user_data_dir_absolute_hint: Leave empty for the default automation setup (dedicated folder under bot/browser_runner/profiles/). Only set for advanced reuse of a non-bot Chrome profile (close all Chrome first; fragile on Windows).
claude._chrome_profile_directory_hint: Optional Chrome profile folder name, e.g. Default or Profile 3 (omit if single profile).
claude._human_verification_snippets_hint: Optional extra substrings (lowercase match on page HTML). Defaults are built-in; see bot/docs/CLAUDE_WEB_LIMITATION.md.

cursor.session_label_hint: FoodKing Agent tab name (for humans only)
